methodology.holdout: last 30%; cold-start, frozen champion, evaluated once per run
methodology.timestamp: completed candle close time = source interval start + interval_seconds
methodology.execution_warning: Real closes, hypothetical fills. Liquidity is assumed, not observed. No alpha claim.
methodology.missing_intervals: not interpolated; gaps longer than one interval cancel pending fills and block entries
